name: schedule-app-e2e-tests
description: Browser tests: the real pages in Chromium against the Firestore/Auth/Storage emulators and the real functions-auth code (docs/tests.md). Run: npm install && PYTHON=<python with functions-auth/requirements.txt> npm test

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:next && npm run test:phone && npm run test:main && npm run test:hr
scripts.test:main: firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-schedule "bash run.sh main.test.js"
scripts.test:hr: firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-schedule "bash run.sh hr.test.js"
scripts.audit: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-schedule "bash run.sh audit.js"
